description.value:
At 2nd level, your sneak attack allows you to weaken the target further through the use of energy. Your rogue level determines the number of energy points you have, as shown in the Energy Points column of the Rogue table.

You can spend these points when you hit a creature with a @UUID[Compendium.wc5e-foundryvtt.class-features.Item.Yh7akRCw716Uv5Ih]{sneak attack} to perform various energy features. You start by knowing three such features: @UUID[Compendium.wc5e-foundryvtt.class-features.Item.qV5R34eqnVkTM2LK]{Cripple}, @UUID[Compendium.wc5e-foundryvtt.class-features.Item.DSLQ71tjUPk398yJ]{Expose Armor}, and @UUID[Compendium.wc5e-foundryvtt.class-features.Item.TQkVHEmVvOYTjPpR]{Garrote}. You may learn more energy features as you gain levels in this class.

When you spend an energy point, it is unavailable until you finish a short or long rest, at the end of which you replenish all of your expended energy.

Your energy features require your target to make a saving throw to resist the feature's effects. The saving throw DC is calculated as follows:

Energy save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier
